utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the first of October. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Unlike the heating in the portakabin, which has apparently decided not to join us.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: You've still got your coat on, then?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Never mind that, whose is the new car in the car park? Takes up about a bay and a half.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the parking, not the car.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, right. Operator error. Familiar story.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: While we're on important matters, the charity bake sale on Friday. Apparently there's proper cake this time.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: What was wrong with the last lot?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing, if you needed a wheel chock.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes evidence against somebody's baking. Finished bits first, please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the dryer yesterday. That's done, not something for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the filter change closed, then?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, finished yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the line two yesterday. Same thing, completed work, just feeding it back.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, yeah. I had that down as yesterday's as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Also, tested the line 2 robot yesterday and it's all fine now. No follow-on job from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Those are all closed, not being rolled over.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: One observation, though. Heard a slight rattle from the Forklift Fleet, nothing to action yet. Just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only, no new job off that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me. Saw the pressure on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: It recovered completely, did it? Sorry, talked over the last bit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, back on its own. Nothing I'm asking anyone to do from that, just the observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Actual work to agree, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the BFP.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc. That's top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll treat the BFP sign-off as top priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just so we're clear, you mean the lock-out tag-out sign-off itself?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly that. Not saying it's signed off already; I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Marc has that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's still the purchase order for the dryer as well. Separate from the filter that's already done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you chase the purchase order for the dryer by the end of the week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the dryer by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, the filter— sorry, you've already said it. Different thing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep. Nobody's asking you to swap it twice.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Fi, just to keep the weighting clear, it matters but it's not urgent. End of the week is what we're agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Understood. That's mine, on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: What about the guarding on the line 2 guard? That's the other item, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll check the guarding on the line 2 guard on the 3rd. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the 3rd, which is Saturday. That's deliberate, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, on the 3rd. Not moving it to tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, Saz has the line 2 guard check on the 3rd, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the pre-use checks on the forklifts? Separate entry from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts next Tuesday. That's fairly important as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got you. Sarah Okafor against the forklifts pre-use checks, next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Next Tuesday, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And that's the planned pre-use checks, not a new investigation from my rattle comment?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Your observation hasn't created another task.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, before we get onto the Stretch Wrapper, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Stretch Wrapper.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that delivery-dependent bit is still blocked, not something we're promising today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Still no confirmation. That's a blocker update, not me adding a chase.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The existing jam is separate from that delivery, though. I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Stretch Wrapper by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, the jam and the sensors, not taking on the supplier delivery as well?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just the jam and sensor check. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Marc, clear the jam and check the sensors on the Stretch Wrapper by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Agreed, I'll do that. Separate from the blocked delivery.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's clear now. The work Marc's taken isn't dependent on that delivery; the delivery-dependent work stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. No extra supplier job coming out of my update.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's the distinction I wanted. No accidental extras on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing else from quality. Mine was just the completed filter change.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing else from me either. Except I feel the wheel-chock cake comment may come back to haunt me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You're on Teams. There's witnesses.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Plenty of them. Right, we're agreed. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cheers.
